about: The 18 March and 7 May Lanoxin supplies each cover 50 days at 250 micrograms daily. Together they cover 100 consecutive days, and the 12 May eGFR is 24 mL/min/1.73 m2.
Possible finding: the June and October Lanoxin PG supplies follow a new dosing plan, but the daily dose, coverage between refills and latest eGFR are unresolved.

Lanoxin 250 microgram (digoxin) is supplied 5 times from January 2026 to August 2026, but the record holds an eGFR of 41 mL/min/1.73 m2 dated 2026-03-02, which is not low enough for the criterion, so there is no finding.
